{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and customer_segment, then sum revenue
channel_segment_revenue = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum()

# Display the grouped revenue
channel_segment_revenue"}
